[{:db/id 17592186142798 :knowledge-point/questions ["question-b11f04e7-08c8-5f47-98ca-f9bed3019d8e" "question-e01a2c34-8ac1-5c1d-8c31-0ae504dfb7c8" "question-4d60fb24-9c3e-583a-bd44-72b00cae8e44" "question-f2ec4fda-aa3e-5894-ae68-873ea21a07ad" "question-83a10579-467e-5020-9446-f0bcbebf0762"] :db/ensure [:knowledge-point/validate]} {:db/id 17592186142589 :question/problem "Calculate the value of $4 \times 1\,\dfrac{2}{7},$ expressing the result as a mixed number." :question/worked-solution "First, we write $4$ as an improper fraction:

$$

$$

$$

$$
\dfrac{36}{7} = 5\,\textrm{R}\,1 = 5\,\dfrac{1}{7}
$$" :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id 17592186142799 :knowledge-point/questions ["question-8cf2b8e2-2314-5e9d-b171-6805247e3cfc" "question-b13fbae9-cf7a-599c-b37d-114ee2f7bfd9" "question-9d97e614-0772-528b-a353-38b67fdb040e" "question-b0e3e224-39c7-55c1-9017-33330a41adbe" "question-d47e615f-58e6-5902-88f8-098ef1f1c1bf"] :db/ensure [:knowledge-point/validate]} {:db/id 17592186142654 :question/problem "Multiply $4 \times 2\,\dfrac{1}{4}.$" :question/worked-solution "First, we write $4$ as an improper fraction:

$$

$$

$$

$$" :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id 17592186142800 :knowledge-point/questions ["question-2f78e4f9-faf2-56cf-8be7-d24c50f82032" "question-9c5c53ba-1c75-5a47-95b1-d73845f940f1" "question-bae0062b-f5ac-5baa-b921-966c2cbaf487" "question-545b365b-c759-5099-8acb-b948f190db31"] :db/ensure [:knowledge-point/validate]} {:db/id 17592186142653 :question/problem "Calculate the value of $2\,\dfrac 2 {9} \times 3,$ expressing the result as a mixed number." :question/worked-solution "First, we write  $2\,\dfrac{2}{9}$ as an improper fraction:
